subject.title: fix(agents): cloud thinking models time out at 120s during reasoning (#80349) [AI-assisted]

question: After the code is rebased and the first-event timeout surface is addressed, should maintainers require a completed live Gemini thinking turn before merge, or accept source-level resolver proof plus CI because Google quota is unavailable?
rationale: The remaining acceptance choice is about proof sufficiency and the intentional default-timeout tradeoff; automation cannot produce the contributor's live Google setup evidence or accept that risk on behalf of maintainers.

options.title: Require live Gemini proof
options.body: Ask for redacted logs, terminal output, or a recording from a non-off Gemini thinking turn showing it no longer fails around 125s after the rebased fix.

options.title: Accept source proof after repair
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the resolver/unit proof and reached-endpoint evidence after the first-event/rebase gap is fixed, while owning the lack of a completed live turn.

options.title: Pause until refreshed
options.body: Leave the PR open but unmergeable until the contributor rebases and supplies proof, or close later only if the stale/unproven close criteria are met.

recommendation.title: Require live Gemini proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted logs, terminal output, or a recording from a non-off Gemini thinking turn showing it no longer fails around 125s after the rebased fix.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the recent owner of the current-main first-event timeout surface and has adjacent timeout-policy history in this area.
